profile.notes: Square source; design for circular crop. Keep the full mark inside a generous central safe area.

header.notes: Responsive crop varies by device; keep critical logo/text away from edges and profile-photo overlap.

personalCover.notes: Keep important content centered/right enough to survive profile-photo overlap and responsive cropping.

pageLogo.notes: Square logo source. Preserve breathing room.

pageCover.notes: Use a safe central composition; page UI can crop differently across surfaces.

profile.notes: Square source designed for circular display. Export larger internal masters if needed, but keep this delivery target available.

cover.notes: 2× working export for a common 820×312 display ratio. Keep critical content centered for desktop/mobile crop differences.

avatar.notes: Working master for organization/avatar use. GitHub renders at multiple sizes, so keep the mark bold and centered.

socialPreview.notes: Repository/social preview asset. Keep primary identity and message in the center-safe area.

profile.notes: Square high-resolution channel profile source designed for YouTube's circular crop; YouTube currently renders the profile image at 98×98 px.

banner.notes: YouTube recommended channel banner size. Critical logo and text stay inside the centered cross-device safe area; the safe area here is scaled from YouTube's official 1235×338 safe area at its 2048×1152 minimum upload size.

watermark.notes: YouTube video watermark minimum size is 150×150 px and must remain under 1 MB. Use the Ink tile for reliable contrast over arbitrary video frames.

profile.notes: Google does not publish a required Gmail profile-photo pixel size. This is a high-resolution square working master designed for the circular Google Account crop; the Gmail profile picture is the Google Account profile picture and can appear across Google services.

signatureLogo.notes: Transparent light-ground lockup for Gmail signatures. Google recommends signature images 70–100 px high by 300–400 px wide; 400×100 uses the top end of that recommended range.

og.notes: Default Open Graph and social-sharing card.

favicon16.notes: Use the dedicated pixel-drawn small glyph, not a scaled master mark.

appleTouchIcon.notes: Opaque full-bleed square; iOS applies its own mask.

iphone.notes: iPhone 16 Pro Max native resolution; a high-res portrait master that scales down cleanly to other recent iPhones. Minimal by design: the clock sits top, the dock bottom, so the centered mark stays clear of both.

desktop4k.notes: 4K desktop master; scales down well to 1440p and 1080p. Minimal: centered lockup with generous empty space so desktop icons never sit on anything important.
